configure_cmake_project: configure a CMake project by running cmake with generator, build type, and dependency paths
build_cmake_project: build a CMake project in parallel using cmake --build with configurable job count
install_cmake_artifacts: install built CMake artifacts to a target directory with optional post-install file copying
build_configure_command: build a CMake configure command list with generator, cross-compilation, and user-specified options
run_cmake_command: run a subprocess command with logging, quiet mode, and configurable output verbosity levels
